# FunkYouSHiFT

Official site: https://www.funkyoushift.com/

FunkYouSHiFT is a Borderlands modding hub for Discord help, save editors, SDK tools, builds, streams, giveaways, and merch.

Primary pages:
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-modding.html — modding guide for modded weapons, saves, and where to start
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-builds.html — BL4 planner, creator build videos, and Discord feedback
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-resources.html — save editors, MSBT, SDK mods, GZO, and install guides
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-discord.html — Borderlands Discord for trading, modded gear, and help

Merged/redirected pages:
- borderlands-modded-weapons.html redirects to borderlands-modding.html
- borderlands-trading.html redirects to borderlands-discord.html
- borderlands-build-videos.html redirects to borderlands-builds.html

Discord: https://discord.com/servers/funk-s-borderlands-trading-hub-997021744764289084
Version: 4.0.27

- The Donate/Support page includes The Hunt and charity event information, with links to St. Jude PLAY LIVE and Discord for updates.
## Tools hub update v4.0.27
- The visitor-facing Tools page is `/borderlands-resources.html` with aliases `/tools`, `/save-editors`, `/modding-tools`, `/sdk-mods`, and related redirects.
- Tools is a franchise-wide Borderlands hub, not BL4-only: save editors, item editors, SDK mods, mod databases, guides, save locations, trainers, planners, and Discord help.
- `/borderlands-modding.html` remains the SEO explainer and should funnel users to Tools and Discord.

## Mobile/page speed-bump cleanup v4.0.27
- Home keeps the visual What do you need launcher because it is the main navigation for Twitch viewers.
- Tools no longer uses a large What do you need panel before the embeds; it uses a compact shortcut bar so the editor hub appears sooner.
- Discord and Modding pages use compact shortcut bars instead of repeating card routers.
